messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 Pager: GPU queue length > 10k for region-us-east-1. Autoscaler attempted hires but new nodes failing to join cluster. Impact: inference latency spike, some customer requests 503. Playbook: https://redwood/playbooks/gpu-provision

sam: seeing kubelet registration errors on the new instances. Node create -> provisioning -> fails to become Ready.

li: logs from the node show IMDSv2 enforcement flag in the launch template. kubelet bootstrap script tries IMDSv1 and times out.

priya: @oncall-2 can you take this? notify SRE rotation. I can help with launch template rollback. :eyes:

oncall-2: taking. Joining bridge in 2m. Initial triage: cluster-autoscaler shows RegisterFailedBackoff for 4 nodes, error: "kubelet node registration failed: token not accepted"

sam: dumping kubelet journal from one failing node:
```
Jul 08 12:40:03 ip-10-0-1-45 kubelet[1234]: I0708 12:40:03.123456 1234 server.go:... Failed to authenticate to kube-apiserver: token expired
Jul 08 12:40:04 ip-10-0-1-45 cloud-init: IMDSv2 required but script attempted v1; metadata request failed
```

priya: that matches the change that rolled last night to enforce IMDSv2 on GPU pool. The launch template got updated but user data still assumes v1.

oncall-2: impact summary so far: queue backlog growing -> rate limiter throttle engaged -> API retries -> increased 5xx to customers A and C. Triage priority: 1) get nodes joining 2) relieve queue 3) rollback template.

customer-ops: Customer A reported degraded throughput on their job queues, some timeouts. CS notified. No data exfiltration.

li: quick mitigation: we can temporarily set autoscaler to prefer existing CPU-only pool for non-GPU work and drain GPU-bound non-critical replica sets. But many pods are GPU-sched because of nodeSelector.

sam: manual workaround tested: launch a single node with a patched user-data (IMDSv2-aware curl) -> kubelet registers -> pods schedule. Verified by spawning a test node via EC2 console.

oncall-2: doing that now for a few nodes to relieve backlog. Patching user-data and creating 3 nodes. Will monitor queue.

priya: rolling back the enforced-IMDS change on the GPU launch template in staging is already done. Need approval to apply to prod template. Who's OK to approve rollback?

sam: +1 from infra to rollback until we update bootstrap scripts. This is low-risk and will restore prior behavior.

oncall-2: applying rollback to launch template version 12 -> 11 for gpu-pool-us-east-1 now. Creating 3 nodes with old template to test.

incident-bot: update: autoscaler shows new nodes Registered. Pending pods moving to Running. Queue length decreasing (from 10.2k -> 6.1k).

customer-ops: CS updated Customer A and C: mitigation in progress, ETA for full restoration ~20m.

li: postmortem note: root cause = bootstrap user-data not compatible with new IMDSv2-only templates. Change rolled without validating node bootstrap. Remediation: (1) add IMDSv2-aware metadata calls in bootstrap; (2) add canary template validation step before applying wide rollouts; (3) autoscaler should fallback to alternative pools when GPU nodes fail to join.

priya: action items assigned: priya -> test and land bootstrap changes (PR #3142), sam -> create canary pipeline for launch template updates, li -> update playbook with IMDSv2 validation steps. oncall-2 -> confirm queue drained and close pager.

oncall-2: queue at 1.2k, 95p latency back within SLOs. Closing pager in 10m after final checks. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Pager closed by oncall-2. Final status: partial rollback applied, manual node adds, customer notifications sent, follow-ups assigned.
